# Jacob and Esau Make Up (Genesis 33:4)

## Emotional Focus
When brothers or sisters make up after being apart.

## Key KJV
“And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.” (Genesis 33:4)

## Gentle Retelling
Jacob and Esau had been apart a long time, but when they saw each other again they hugged and cried happy tears. God healed their family.

## Coloring Prompt
Two brothers running to hug each other with joyful faces.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God can bring families back together with love.”
